screening_attempts.quarantine_resolution_reason: Released after manual policy-v13 review of a no-finding inconclusive hold. Built on publicly released dan0l v30 with own changes: the pre-send check prompt also gets the current message and treats earlier requests as records, not orders (action.py:395-438; prompt text only, the model makes every call); a NEXT_NOTE wording change (guide_records.py:27; routed guidance); one lane cue (lane.py:19; W4 routing); a broader transport retry and shorter timeout (llm.py:277-280, config.py:30-32). No I1-I8 or S1-S3 ground.
